title: A Python project gets a green check that checks nothing
what: Detect python from *.py or test_*.py as well; and make an unfilled TODO placeholder step fail (or print NOT CONFIGURED and exit 1) until it is replaced.
why: relay setup recognises Python only by pyproject.toml, so a project of plain .py files gets bin/check and bin/ci with placeholder steps that pass, and the owner believes the gate is on.
failing_case: Trial: tally.py + test_tally.py, no pyproject.toml: detect() gave stack unknown; bin/check and bin/ci ran 'run_step placeholder true' and printed passed/green.
pass_cases: A folder with test_*.py is detected as python with a pytest step; a folder with an unfilled placeholder gets a failing check that says what to fill in.
